name: Kadosh Pass
description: Cofre de senhas zero-knowledge da Kadosh — autofill por domínio, anti-phishing.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://kpass.kadoshcompany.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
